gsw_noDevices: No segment-capable devices found. Enter a Cloud API key in the adapter settings so device capabilities are known.
gsw_measureHint: Watch the strip — which segment lights up bright white?
gsw_reviewHint: Click a cell to flip lit / gap, then apply.
gsw_conn_lan_desc: Local control for lights. No credentials needed.
gsw_conn_cloud_desc: Optional. Adds device names, scenes, snapshots and segments.
gsw_conn_rt_desc: Optional. Enables live status push over the Govee cloud (AWS IoT).
gsw_conn_2fa_hint: Govee sent a verification code by email. Enter it here to finish sign-in.
gsw_conn_st_ok: Connected. Save the settings to keep real-time status enabled.
gsw_conn_st_verifyRequired: Govee needs a verification code for this device. Check your email and enter the code.
gsw_conn_st_codeInvalid: The verification code is invalid. Request a new one and try again.
gsw_conn_st_passwordRejected: Email or password was rejected. Please check your credentials.
gsw_conn_st_emailNotRegistered: This email is not registered with Govee.
gsw_conn_st_rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a while before trying again.
gsw_conn_st_accountLocked: The account is temporarily locked by Govee. Try again later.
gsw_conn_st_mqttNotUp: Real-time service is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
gsw_conn_st_codeSent: A new verification code was sent to your email.
gsw_conn_st_codeRejected: Govee rejected the verification code. Request a new one.
gsw_conn_st_throttled: Please wait a moment before requesting another code.
gsw_diagIntro: Pick a device and press the button: the adapter builds a diagnostics report and your browser saves it as a file. Attach that file to a GitHub issue — the issue forms ask for exactly it.
gsw_diagNoDevices: No devices yet. The report is per device — once the adapter has found one, it appears here.
gsw_diagListFailed: Could not load the device list. Is the instance running?
gsw_diagExportFailed: The report could not be created. The adapter log says why.
gsw_diagPrivacy: The report is pseudonymised: addresses, mail addresses and device names are replaced by stable markers, device ids are shortened, and credentials never appear. The file explains this in its own header.
